items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: We used to hear every morning Eddie South, The Dark Angel of the Violin. This was a nationwide broadcast during those days, a live broadcast

ctx.x: Yeah, we had a Victrola, the kind that you have to crank up after every record, wind the record up and you have to change the needle after every five plays -- you know, change the needle. And later on, we got a little table model Philco radio, and we used to listen to the Mills Brothers every morning on the radio, and we used to listen to the Ink Spots.
